question: Which professionals have done at least three treatments? List the professional's id, role, and first name.
gold_query: SELECT T1.professional_id , T1.role_code , T1.first_name FROM Professionals AS T1 JOIN Treatments AS T2 ON T1.professional_id = T2.professional_id GROUP BY T1.professional_id HAVING count(*) >= 3
